title: Maximum Oxygen Uptake in ACL-injured Professional Soccer Players
brief_summary: Our purpose is to evaluate maximum oxygen uptake (VO2max) in ACL-injured professional soccer players and after a six-month period of post-operative rehabilitation, compared to a control group of healthy professional soccer players.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ACL injury
* professional soccer player
* adult
* male

Exclusion Criteria:

* Multiple ligament injury
* knee effusion
* unable to perform the examination on the treadmill
* ACL reconstruction failure
* reoperation due to any cause during the follow-up period
* goalkeeper
